# Kaizan

> Kaizan is client super intelligence for professional services firms: AI that turns client conversations and data into early warnings on relationship health, churn risk and growth opportunities.

## Key pages

- [Our Story: Intelligence for Client Service](https://kaizan.ai/about/): Why Glen Calvert and Pravin Paratey founded Kaizan in London: a proactive system of intelligence for client service and account management teams.
- [Client Success Software](https://kaizan.ai/client-success-software/): Kaizan is client success software that turns every call, email and signal into the next best action, AI Helpers that work 24/7 to grow client ROI, satisfaction and revenue.
- [Cookie Policy](https://kaizan.ai/cookie-policy/): The cookies Kaizan uses on its website and app, and how to manage them.
- [Clients](https://kaizan.ai/customers/): 60+ client-services teams running Kaizan to keep their clients and grow them.
- [Jellyfish · Client story](https://kaizan.ai/customers/jellyfish/): Standardised account health across 9 offices in a quarter.
- [Scale Digital · Client story](https://kaizan.ai/customers/scale/): Expansion signals that used to take weeks now hit the desk same day.
- [The Kite Factory · Client story](https://kaizan.ai/customers/the-kite-factory/): Three saves in one quarter that we would have missed.
- [Verkeer · Client story](https://kaizan.ai/customers/verkeer/): How Verkeer cut QBR prep from 6 hours to 40 minutes.
- [Data Processing Agreement](https://kaizan.ai/data-processing-agreement/): How Kaizan processes personal data on behalf of its customers.
- [Kaizan FAQs: Pricing, Integrations, Setup](https://kaizan.ai/faq/): Answers on what Kaizan is, how it works, integrations, the free 14-day pilot, pricing and annual contracts, outcomes, comparisons and how to work with us.
- [For Client Service / Account Manager](https://kaizan.ai/for/account-manager/): Kaizan removes the admin and surfaces the next best action on every client - so you spend your time on the work only you can do.
- [AI Portfolio Risk Alerts for Service Directors](https://kaizan.ai/for/client-service-director/): Spot client dissatisfaction before the renewal call, onboard new team members in days and see portfolio patterns no single account manager can.
- [For Head of AI / CTO](https://kaizan.ai/for/head-of-ai/): Turn every meeting, email, and decision into a unified client brain your AI tools can query - and a foundation for the custom products, services, and workflows your business wants to build.
- [AI Client Intelligence for Senior Leaders](https://kaizan.ai/for/leadership/): See where each client can grow and catch risks early. Kaizan turns every meeting and signal into intelligence senior leaders use to plan growth and renewals.
- [Pitch Prep and Account Growth for New Business](https://kaizan.ai/for/new-business/): Prepare for pitches without hours of research. Kaizan surfaces stakeholder context, competitor signals and expansion opportunities for new business teams.
- [Client Interaction Data for Operations Leaders](https://kaizan.ai/for/performance/): See where the hours go, which processes are landing and how client sentiment is trending, with data that flows into the BI tools your team already uses.
- [AI Project Status and Scope Tracking for PMs](https://kaizan.ai/for/project-manager/): One always-current view of every project, status and commitment. Kaizan drafts status updates, flags scope drift and feeds a live risk register for PMs.
- [For Strategy, Creative, Marketing](https://kaizan.ai/for/strategy-creative-marketing/): Every conversation, decision, and signal on every client - ready the moment the brief lands.
- [Client Success Software](https://kaizan.ai/): Kaizan is client success software that turns every call, email and signal into the next best action, AI Helpers that work 24/7 to grow client ROI, satisfaction and revenue.
- [Client Tool Integrations: Free Standard Set](https://kaizan.ai/integrations/): All standard Kaizan integrations are free: Teams, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Meet and more unify client data, plus the Kaizan API and custom builds.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://kaizan.ai/knowledge-hub/): Client success and account management FAQs: a resource hub covering client intelligence, onboarding, retention, client health, reviews, reporting, expansion, metrics and AI for account managers.
- [Licence Agreement](https://kaizan.ai/license-agreement/): The terms on which Kaizan Limited supplies the Kaizan software.
- [Free iced coffee this July](https://kaizan.ai/marketing/july-offer/): Iced coffee's on us this July: enter your email and role to get your free coffee code.
- [Pricing by Client Count, Free 14 Day Pilot](https://kaizan.ai/pricing/): Pricing is set by how many clients you cover, per client per month, with unlimited users on every tier. Every engagement starts with a free 14 day pilot.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kaizan.ai/privacy-policy/): How Kaizan Limited collects, uses and protects your personal data.
- [Product](https://kaizan.ai/product/): AI Assistant, AI Helpers, the Client Health Model and Client News, one platform for AI-first client service teams.
- [Kaizan Referral Partner Program](https://kaizan.ai/referral-partners/): Earn 15% of the first year and 7.5% of the second when you introduce a firm to Kaizan. Book a call with the partner team.
- [Our Research](https://kaizan.ai/research/): The 2026 Client Service Report from Kaizan: the data on what great client service actually looks like, drawn from 1M+ anonymised client conversations.
- [Security & Trust](https://kaizan.ai/security/): How Kaizan secures your data, handles privacy, and governs the AI behind the product.
